title: kiln.assets content blob catalog: a snapshot page
description: The JSON of Kiln.Assets' catalog records (managed/services/Kiln.Assets/BlobCatalog.cs: BlobCatalogInfo, BlobCatalogEntry; System.Text.Json writes and reads this shape). The C structs are KilnBlobCatalogInfo and KilnBlobCatalogEntry in native/core/abi/services/kiln_assets.h. uint64 fields are decimal strings. A page: the snapshot's info and some of its entries, sorted by (size, hash0, hash1, hash2). Docs: docs/kiln/services/assets.md.

first.description: The index of entries[0] in the snapshot.

u64.description: An unsigned 64-bit number as a decimal string.

generation.description: The catalog's generation the snapshot was built at (it moves on every registration, removal, mod unload and readiness change).

total.description: Entries in the snapshot; "0" without one.

gameComplete.description: The game's whole content index is in the snapshot.

registrationsComplete.description: Every live registration is in the snapshot.

contentHash.description: <size>-<h0>-<h1>-<h2>: decimal size, hex words (as assets.json and ContentHash.ToString()).

origins.description: game when the game's index lists the hash (also when a mod overrides it), plus every live registration's origin.

selectedOrigin.description: Whose bytes are served now; game for the game's own.

owner.description: The served registration's native owner; "0" for the game's own.

sequence.description: The served registration's number; "0" for the game's own.

overridden.description: The game lists the hash and a registration's bytes are served in its place.
